people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Sodom
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins

translations.web: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
